facts.fact: 回家日：Jake 的拥抱不带惯常调侃——一句「I missed you」让她当场落泪。
facts.anchor: He hugs me, and there’s no gentle teasing that goes with it.

facts.fact: 对 Jake 交底：奖学金误会已解决（别担心）；核心认账「I freaked out on him」。
facts.anchor: I sorted that out, so don’t stress.

facts.fact: 她的自省：我在处理自己的事，却把火撒在他身上——「不知道怎么修复，我们再没说过话」。
facts.anchor: I was dealing with my own things and took it out on him.

facts.fact: Jake 的成人智慧：分开一阵对彼此都好——「是命中注定就跑不掉」。
facts.anchor: If it’s meant to be it’s meant to be.

facts.fact: 农场三周循环日常的黑色幽默收尾：起床、早饭、修篱笆、喂鸡、对虚空尖叫、重复。
成绩短信：87 分——正是她上次挂掉的那门课。「I passed. With flying colours.」
facts.anchor: 87. Me. 87. For a subject I failed last time.

facts.fact: 誓约现况：过考就该开口——但她没打、不能打、「Not yet」。
facts.anchor: I told myself that if I passed I would talk to him.

facts.fact: 庆功宴邀约被她急刹车：Dad 话到一半（想问他要不要来），她一个「No」掐断。
facts.anchor: Dinner just as a family sounds good.

facts.fact: Charlie 餐桌拆绷带：你答应过带他回来！他也答应过要回来！
facts.anchor: You promised you would bring him back! He promised to come back!

facts.fact: 章末钩子：车灯橙光里的归家车道——她看见了他。
facts.anchor: And that’s when I see him.
